Reduced raid admits cap-minus-one Players plus pet, with surplus Players in actual GM mode so native zone-combat pulses cannot re-add them. Current chooses all eligible Players and no pet; pinned48b57e05 selects the pet in every case. Full raid chooses exactly three/five distinct Players including current victim in every current case; the accepted reference also omitted its tank in every full-raid case (random observation, not a deterministic negative assertion).

Initial rejected probe removed threat references but left surplus ordinary Players visible. Native zone-combat re-added them before the event; this was a fixture prerequisite, not an additional server bug. GM mode fixes the controlled input without bypassing the event.

Existing native dispel/expiry/Essence/reset/victory regressions pass in all eight cases for current and pinned reference. Canonical Release normal final-link build and existing bounded PE checks pass.
